items.summary: Navy shares a 49-yard Gutierrez-to-Collins scoring highlight.
Theo Lawson reports Gonzaga beat NMSU 109–68, with Harwell and Fogle scoring 22 apiece and Huff scoring 20.
items.source_text:
Final: No. 15 Gonzaga 109, NMSU 68

Some second half, eh? Zags outscore Aggies 62-26 after the break, finish with three 20-point scorers: Harwell (career-high 22), Fogle (ties career-high w/ 22) and Huff (20). Gonzaga finishes 13 of 24 (54%) from the 3-point line. https://t.co/sGfe2u4eel
